subject: Caretaker assignment for Platform Observability - temporary manager plan
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: HR Operations <hr@vendor-co.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Caretaker assignment for Platform Observability - temporary manager plan

Team —

Quick update and request for sign-off. Elena Soto will be on a planned medical leave starting the week of Dec 6 for approximately six weeks. We need a short-term caretaker to maintain day-to-day coverage, own escalations, and ensure P1/P2 runbooks are kept up while keeping performance review and growth check-ins on track.

Proposed caretaker: Aditya Rao (Platform). Scope in the attached caretaker_mandate.pdf — primary responsibilities:
- Triage and own production incidents for observability services
- Run weekly leadership sync with SRE and Infra (stand-up notes in Drive)
- Own ongoing 1:1 cadence for direct reports; coordinate interim performance checkpoints
- Serve as single escalation path for customer issues (esp. Acme Cloud)

I've also attached the updated org chart (org_chart_v2.png) showing temporary reporting lines. Ask: please review and respond with approvals or objections by EOD Wed, Dec 2. HR has been looped for compliance and to process the temporary reassignment paperwork.

If we get sign-off, action items:
1) HR will issue the official temporary assignment and DocuSign the approval form.
2) Aditya and Marcus to split review responsibilities: Aditya covers performance check-ins, Marcus handles on-call rotations and escalation playbooks.
3) I'll send a short communication to the team once paperwork is complete.

Rationale: Elena's team has two ongoing customer escalations (see Acme Cloud thread) and a quarterly retrospective next week — we can't leave the team without a clearly named owner. Aditya has led the observability initiatives and is best placed to keep continuity.

Thanks — please flag any risks I haven't captured.

— Sean
Sean Gallagher
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: caretaker_mandate.pdf, org_chart_v2.png

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: HR Operations <hr@vendor-co.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Caretaker assignment for Platform Observability - temporary manager plan

Sean —

I support this caretaker plan. Aditya is the right choice for continuity. A couple of quick notes:
- For performance checkpoints: recommend we treat these as \"interim reviews\" (not full calibrations) — focus on short-term objectives and any risk signals. Formal calibration can wait until Elena returns.
- Marcus please own the on-call schedule adjustments and ensure the playbook is up-to-date before Dec 6.
- We should draft a two-paragraph team note that Sean can send; call out escalation path and expected timelines.

If HR needs anything from me to expedite approval, say the word.

— Lauren
Director, Engineering Operations

From: HR Operations <hr@vendor-co.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:20:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Caretaker assignment for Platform Observability - temporary manager plan

Hi Sean / Lauren —

Thanks for the heads-up. HR has reviewed the caretaker_mandate.pdf and the org_chart_v2.png. To finalize the temporary manager assignment we need the following completed before we can issue the formal notice:
1) Signed approval form (attached as a DocuSign link in REQ-8472) — the link is in the related_links field in your request.
2) Confirmation of scope (one paragraph) from the caretaker (Aditya) acknowledging temporary responsibilities and duration.
3) A note confirming compensation or reporting exceptions (if any) — if none, please reply with \"No exceptions.\"

Once we have the signed form and caretaker confirmation we'll route the assignment through People Ops and publish the org change. DocuSign processing normally takes <24 hours once signed.

If you prefer, we can accept a scanned signed PDF (approval_form_signed.pdf) but DocuSign is preferred for audit trails.

Regards,
HR Operations
HR & Compliance Team
Vendor HR Services

Thanks all — I'm happy to take the caretaker role.

Per HR checklist:
1) I have completed the paragraph acknowledging scope below and attached the signed PDF (approval_form_signed.pdf). DocuSign was completed via REQ-8472 and the audit trail shows as completed.

Scope confirmation (Aditya Rao): I accept temporary assignment as caretaker for the Platform Observability team from Dec 6 through Jan 17 (approx.). I will own incident triage and customer escalations, run weekly leadership syncs, and maintain 1:1s for direct reports. I will escalate any performance calibration decisions to Sean and Lauren.

2) No exceptions on compensation or reporting.

Next steps from my side: I'll:
- Publish an updated on-call rota and post the link in the team Slack channel by EOD Monday.
- Share a short message for Sean to send to the team (1–2 paragraphs) with the escalation contact.
- Schedule weekly check-ins with Elena's direct reports and run the first leadership sync on Monday at 11am.

If there's anything else HR needs to close the loop, ping me.

— Aditya
Engineering Manager, Platform

Attachments: approval_form_signed.pdf
